sheets.prompt:
Create a new Arcana Guardians roster comparison sheet by using the second reference sheet as the visual template and REPLACING ALL FOUR CHARACTER IDENTITIES with the new theme characters below. This expands the same game's character family.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: The FIRST reference's TOP ROW OF FOUR BASE HEROES is the authority for compact heroic proportions and painted game materials. The SECOND reference establishes the approved four-panel layout, presentation, faces and surface finish. DO NOT copy the eastern characters, tiger, talisman mage, or smith identities from that sheet; all four new identities are described below.

All four characters must look like the same game's base heroes: approximately 2.5 to 3 heads tall from skull to soles EXCLUDING headwear, horns, ears and weapons. Large expressive adult-hero heads about a third of standing body height, tiny neck, short compact torso, short thick limbs, big hands/gauntlets, big boots/paws, oversized clearly identifiable signature weapons. Compact adult fantasy heroes, not literal infants. Keep even human women compact, not 5-7-head fashion figures. Every species is recognizably distinct. Four significantly different silhouettes, equipment and roles, not palette swaps.

MATERIAL STYLE: polished hand-painted three-dimensional fantasy game illustration closely matching the references, rich saturated but coordinated colors, soft warm light and cool local shadows, beveled edges and broad sculpted volumes. Cloth is matte with broad folds; leather has coarse limited stitching; wood has a few broad grain strokes; metal has broad controlled gold/copper/steel highlights; fur or feathers are large sculpted clumps; stone and gems have few broad facets. No photographic pores, fine textile noise, tiny repeated filigree, overly realistic proportions, glossy vinyl doll material, flat vector art, gritty horror, or modern guns. Each design has a dominant material, contrasting cloth, one small element accent. Leave negative space between hands/weapons and body for game readability.

PRESENTATION: square high-quality concept board, exactly four equal panels in a 2x2 grid. Clean warm pale parchment background, fine muted-gold dividers. Same view and scale as reference: full-body three-quarter view with subtle view from above, grounded neutral ready pose, small soft contact shadow, generous margins. Show ALL heads, feet, tails and weapon tips fully within each panel. No scenery, pedestals, tower structures or UI. Simple black labels A top left, B top right, C bottom left, D bottom right; no other text or title. Each panel contains exactly one character.

THEME: a fictional desert oasis kingdom with sandstone, glazed turquoise ceramics, broad linen wraps, indigo and saffron accents, warm brass. Original fantasy design, no real national or religious symbols.
A TOP LEFT: adult brown-skinned human woman caravan guardian, large expressive face, dark short braid, ivory head wrap leaving face open, indigo short cloak, compact scale vest, oversized curved sword with broad brass guard and a round turquoise ceramic-faced buckler. Very short stout heroic legs and broad boots.
B TOP RIGHT: fennec fox sand-mage with enormous distinctive ears, huge friendly fox head, very short round body, saffron and turquoise loose robe, brass hourglass staff with clear amber sand chambers and one large ceramic flask on belt. Face readable, rounded paws.
C BOTTOM LEFT: jackal beastfolk solar guard, very large black jackal head and broad gold collar with simple sun medallion, ivory linen apron over dark teal compact armor, a broad crescent poleaxe with sandstone/brass socket, short powerful legs.
D BOTTOM RIGHT: squat animated sandstone-and-glazed-pottery golem, large friendly mask-like ceramic head, massive round shoulders, thick short stone limbs and oversized hands, turquoise geometric inlays and a simple brass-bound block mace. Clearly a ceramic/stone construct, not another fur humanoid. Use one bold emblem per design, not intricate filigree.

A TOP LEFT: adult female dwarf master smith with huge expressive broad face, thick braided copper-red hair, strong broad shoulders, short stout body, dark leather apron over teal shirt, oversized square forge hammer, iron gauntlets, brass goggles pushed onto hair; cheerful resolute expression.
B TOP RIGHT: salamander beastfolk foundry lancer, enormous rounded dark-red salamander head with bright amber eyes and a few large orange spots, compact body and curled thick tail, short charcoal forge-coat, copper plates and very chunky long smith-tongs lance. Keep the animal face, do not turn into a human.
C BOTTOM LEFT: compact obsidian sentinel, oversized angular helmet-like stone head with two warm amber eyes, very broad shoulders and very short legs, a few big cooled black volcanic plates with thin orange cracks, huge tower shield shaped like a furnace door, oversized free iron fist. No countless spikes.
D BOTTOM RIGHT: adult human ash engineer with tan skin, huge round determined face, dark curls, short compact body, charcoal hood, thick copper goggles and boots, leather utility harness with one round fuel canister, a large readable handheld fantasy bellows-cannon of wood/copper/iron. Exaggerated broad nozzle, no smoke obscuring face or weapon.

A TOP LEFT: adult human woman sky-lance knight, large expressive brown-eyed face, short dark auburn hair, short compact athletic heroic body, rounded ivory enamel breastplate, sky-blue short cape, broad golden wing-shaped shoulder plates and oversized winged spear; feather motifs are equipment rather than full anatomical wings.
B TOP RIGHT: owl beastfolk archivist, enormous round owl face and clear amber eyes, tiny broad body, ivory/sky-blue scholar robe, big soft feather clumps, open chunky brass-bound grimoire in one hand and a short staff crowned with a simple cloud-shaped gem in the other.
C BOTTOM LEFT: ram beastfolk cloud-bell monk, huge head with thick curved ram horns and broad muzzle, stocky round body, ivory quilted cloth and sky-blue sash, broad golden wrist cuffs and a large bell-headed mallet resting beside him, short heavy hooves. Kind elder face.
D BOTTOM RIGHT: swallow birdfolk wind courier, oversized dark-blue and cream bird head, compact body with short arms, a short feather cape that reads as folded wings, sky-blue leather harness, oversized feather-shaped boomerang held visibly away from body and a scroll satchel. All feet and tools visible.

B TOP RIGHT: adult dark-brown-skinned human bog witch, large warm expressive face, dark coiled hair under a broad moss-green pointed hat, very short compact body, plum skirt/coat and amber brooch, a chunky twisted root staff carrying one golden lantern, small herb satchel. Friendly confident adult face.
C BOTTOM LEFT: crocodile reed-shield bruiser, very large broad green crocodile head with a few large rounded teeth, huge shoulders and short thick legs, copper arm cuffs and woven reed chest guard, broad oval bundled-reed shield reinforced with wood and an oversized blunt bone club. Tail stays inside frame.

Friendly heroic insect silhouette, not a human wearing insect armor.
